fact: 列宁在1922年把新经济政策（NEP）界定为一种「自由市场与资本主义，两者都受国家控制」的经济制度，同时国营企业按「利润原则」运营。NEP在1921年3月俄共第十次代表大会上通过，1922年进入具体制度建设阶段：部分撤销工业全面国有化，允许私人拥有中小型企业，国家继续控制大型工业、银行与对外贸易，并吸引外国资本。

sources.title: Wikipedia, New Economic Policy
sources.quote: Lenin characterized the NEP in 1922 as an economic system that would include "a free market and capitalism, both subject to state control", while socialized state enterprises would operate on "a profit basis". ... The Soviet authorities partially revoked the complete nationalization of industry (established during the period of war communism of 1918 to 1921) and introduced a mixed economy which allowed private individuals to own small and medium-sized enterprises, while the state continued to control large industries, banks and foreign trade. ... Other policies included monetary reform (1922–1924) and the attraction of foreign capital.

fact: 1922年12月29日，俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国、乌克兰苏维埃社会主义共和国、白俄罗斯苏维埃社会主义共和国与外高加索苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国在莫斯科签署《苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟成立宣言与条约》，12月30日经第一次全联盟苏维埃代表大会批准生效，苏联正式成立。签字人为加里宁、茨哈卡亚、彼得罗夫斯基、切尔维亚科夫。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Treaty on the Creation of the USSR
sources.quote: Signed 29 December 1922 ... Effective 30 December 1922 ... The Treaty, along with the Declaration of the Creation of the USSR was approved on 30 December 1922 by a conference of delegations from the Russian SFSR, the Transcaucasian SFSR, the Ukrainian SSR and the Byelorussian SSR. The Treaty and the Declaration were confirmed by the First All-Union Congress of Soviets and signed by heads of delegations – Mikhail Kalinin, Mikhail Tskhakaya, and Grigory Petrovsky, Alexander Chervyakov respectively on December 30, 1922.

fact: 1922年，耐普曼（NEPmen，利用NEP提供的私人贸易与小规模制造机会的商人）占苏联零售贸易的将近75%。他们的角色是把贸易扩展到政府无法覆盖的地区；同时他们被严密监视、课以重税，并被剥夺选举权。

sources.title: Wikipedia, New Economic Policy
sources.quote: In fact, in 1922 the NEPmen accounted for almost 75% of the Soviet Union's retail trade. ... They were closely scrutinized and heavily taxed, and their right to vote was revoked.

fact: 1922年饥荒救援达到峰值：美国救济署（ARA）在苏联每日供食超过1000万人，提供的面粉、谷物、大米、豆类、猪肉、牛奶与糖价值超过9800万美元；动用237艘船、200名美国人指挥、当地12.5万苏联人参与卸货、仓储、搬运、称重、烹饪与分发，设立逾2.1万个新厨房。ARA还在69艘船上运送12.5万个医疗包裹，重1500万磅。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Russian famine of 1921–1922
sources.quote: Over 10 million people were fed daily, with the bulk of food coming from the ARA, which had provided more than 768 million tons of flour, grain, rice, beans, pork, milk, and sugar, with a value of over $98 million. To transport and distribute the food ... the ARA used 237 ships, under the direction of 200 Americans and with the help of 125,000 Russians on location ... in more than 21,000 new kitchens. ... There were 125,000 medical packages, weighing 15 million pounds, sent on 69 ships.

fact: 1922年冬，饥荒区的致命问题不只是粮食：燃料匮乏无法取暖与炊煮，数百万农民衣着近乎褴褛，面临冻死风险。孤儿院等机构的儿童通常只有一件衣服（常以面粉袋改制），缺少鞋、袜、内衣。哈斯克尔上校电告胡佛，至少100万名儿童急需衣物，胡佛随即发起衣物募集与运送计划。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Russian famine of 1921–1922
sources.quote: He explained that fuel was unavailable for heating or cooking and millions of Russian peasants had clothing consisting mostly of rags, which would lead to certain death from cold exposure during the approaching winter. The children at risk included those in orphanages and other institutions, as they usually had only one garment, often made of flour sacks, and they lacked shoes, stockings, underclothing ... Haskell cabled Hoover that at least one million children were in extreme need of clothes.

fact: NEP的法律框架在1922年成型：法律认可公私部门并存，私人可拥有中小型企业，国家保留对大型工业、银行与对外贸易的控制；土地私有仅在国家允许的范围内存在，因为集体化遭到强烈反对。列宁政权同时向国际资本开放，愿意提供「对外国资本主义的慷慨租让」，以换取外汇与技术。

sources.title: Wikipedia, New Economic Policy
sources.quote: The laws sanctioned the co-existence of private and public sectors ... Some kinds of foreign investments were expected by the Soviet Union under the NEP, in order to fund industrial and developmental projects with foreign exchange or technology requirements. ... Under the NEP, not only were "private property, private enterprise, and private profit largely restored in Lenin's Russia", but Lenin's regime turned to international capitalism for assistance, willing to provide "generous concessions to foreign capitalism". ... With the NEP, the state only allowed private landholdings because the idea of collectivized farming had met strong opposition.

fact: 耐普曼在1922年虽贡献约75%的零售额，法律地位却是不完整的：他们被严密监视、课以重税，选举权被剥夺；苏维埃的宣传机器把反对耐普曼的资本主义活动列为社会主义广告的主要目标之一。同一份经济机会，对不同政治身份的人意味着不同的合法性与税负。

sources.title: Wikipedia, New Economic Policy
sources.quote: The disapproval of the NEP by many members of society greatly affected a NEPman's quality of life. They were closely scrutinized and heavily taxed, and their right to vote was revoked. Socialist advertising was also produced to oppose the NEPmen's capitalistic activities, and this war on capitalism became one of the main goals of Soviet socialist advertising at the time.

fact: 1922年国家银行发行面额1、3、5、10、25切尔沃涅茨的纸币。金卢布等于十分之一切尔沃涅茨；10卢布含8.602克90%纯金，当时合5.14美元。与金卢布并行的1917—1922年纸卢布持续贬值，到1924年3月升至每金卢布兑500亿纸卢布。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Soviet ruble
sources.quote: Upon launch of the New Economic Policy in 1921 came efforts to revive as currency and accounting unit the pre-war gold standard ruble, equal to 1⁄10 of a chervonets (with Rbls 10. equal to 8.602 g of 90% fine gold, then equal to US$5.14). ... These circulated alongside the chervonets notes introduced in 1922 by the State Bank in denominations of 1, 3, 5, 10 and 25 chervontsy. ... climbing to 50 billion paper rubles per gold ruble in March 1924.

fact: NEP在1921—1922年饥荒与旱灾之后带来了产出反弹：农业生产在灾后增长约40%。到1928年，农业与工业生产已恢复到1913年（一战前）水平。同期小型与轻工业大部分落入私人企业家或合作社手中。

sources.title: Wikipedia, New Economic Policy
sources.quote: This increased the peasants' incentive to produce, and in response production jumped by 40% after the drought and famine of 1921–22. ... By 1928, agricultural and industrial production had been restored to the 1913 (pre-World War I) level. ... By 1925 ... Small-scale and light industries were largely in the hands of private entrepreneurs or cooperatives.

fact: 1921—1922年饥荒的死亡人数估计差异极大：1920年代初苏联官方出版物称1921年约500万人死于饥荒及相关疾病（教科书常引此数）；更保守的估计不超过100万；基于ARA医疗部门的评估为200万；另有来源称1000万。霍乱与斑疹伤寒的流行是死亡的重要促成因素。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Russian famine of 1921–1922
sources.quote: An official Soviet publication of the early 1920s concluded that about five million deaths occurred in 1921 from famine and related disease, the number that is usually quoted in textbooks. More conservative figures counted not more than a million, and another assessment, based on the ARA's medical division, spoke of two million. On the other side of the scale, some sources spoke of ten million dead.
